description: Mark an order as fulfilled (delivered) — order managers only. If requested lines are short — an item line never picked, or a model or category line with fewer picked items than its quantity — the call returns { requiresAcknowledgment: true, uncovered } — confirm with YOUR user that the order is complete anyway, then retry with acknowledgeIncomplete: true. If picked items are meanwhile lost/retired it returns the offending items — confirm, then retry with their ids in acknowledgeUnusableItemIds. If picked items have open issues — status defect or in_repair, an open ticket, or an overdue maintenance check — it returns them as itemsWithIssues (each with its status, the first issue's title and the count) — name them to your user, confirm, then retry with their ids in acknowledgeSafetyItemIds. Never pass any acknowledgment without that explicit user confirmation. Fulfilling transfers reserved stock to the order's target. Fails on already-closed orders.

acknowledgeIncomplete.description: Pass true ONLY after your user explicitly confirmed closing over the uncovered lines from a previous requiresAcknowledgment result

acknowledgeSafetyItemIds.description: Pass the ids from itemsWithIssues ONLY after your user explicitly confirmed handing those items out from a previous requiresAcknowledgment result

acknowledgeUnusableItemIds.description: Pass the unusable item ids ONLY after your user explicitly confirmed them from a previous requiresAcknowledgment result

name: fulfill_order

closedAtIso.description: The same moment as an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp — read THIS one; the server does no timezone conversion

instruction.description: What to confirm with your user and how to retry

itemsWithIssues.description: Picked items with open issues: status defect or in_repair, an open ticket, or an overdue maintenance check

count.description: Open tickets plus overdue checks on the item

status.description: defect | in_repair, when the status is one of the two

title.description: The first open ticket's or overdue check's title

requiresAcknowledgment.description: Present and true when nothing was written and a human confirmation is required — retry the SAME call with the acknowledge flag named in `instruction`

uncovered.description: Requested lines that are short: item lines never picked; model and category lines with `filled` of `required` picked

unusableItems.description: Picked items that are meanwhile lost or retired

status.description: Why it is unusable: lost | retired

webUrl.description: Link to this order in the web app — give your user THIS, never the raw `orderId` (that is a machine handle for your next call). Absent when the deployment has no public address

title: Fulfill order
